name: Student of Esoterica Scholar Archetype
body:
While most members of the order of scholars focus on the traditional, core set of 15 studies, your interests in more obscure fields has caused you to branch out.

Esoteric Studies

At 1st level, choose any one basic study available to an archetype you do not have; you gain access to that study—although you do not need to choose it right away. In exchange, choose two traditional scholar studies that you have access to; you lose access to those studies and can never learn them.

At 6th level and every 6 levels thereafter, you can choose any one additional basic study that you do not currently have access to, and exchange access to it for any two basic studies that you have access to but have not yet selected. (You do not need to make these exchanges for additional studies if you do not wish to, but you must decide at 6th level, 12th level, and 18th level whether or not to do so.)

This feature modifies scholar studies.
